issue_context.title: Avoid registering or resolving Func<T> with the container
issue_context.body:
Based on [this comment](https://github.com/dotnet/orleans/pull/3302#discussion_r133552953) by @davidfowl:
> Adding and resolving `Func<T>` will mess with providers that natively support `Func<T>`. I would just get rid of this.

We do plan to get rid of `Func<NodeConfiguration>` anyway in the short/medium term (due to our work with Silo Builder, where we will favor strongly typed POCO options, and resolve them via `IOptionsSnapshot<TOptions>`), but this is just 1 usage of `Func<T>`.

review_comments: Intention here is to break the dependency on Silo, since Silo is now being constructed by DI when the builder is being used.
